title: The Year Everything Went Mobile
narrative: Bitcoin's first block is mined in the shadow of a financial crisis. WhatsApp kills SMS. 4G makes mobile internet actually fast. Uber invents the gig economy. Angry Birds proves everyone's a gamer. The mobile-first world is no longer coming — it's here.
